name: elasticsearch-ingest
description: Load local CSV, JSON array, and NDJSON files into Elasticsearch indices with the bulk API through the `elastic` CLI, creating an explicit mapping first when field types matter. Use when batch-importing local files, loading a pre-formed bulk NDJSON body, or verifying document counts and mappings after a load — not for Logstash pipelines, Beats, Elastic Agent, continuous ingestion, or index-to-index reindex.
